# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/docsReference.mjs from package.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command below is in the **Command Palette** (`⇧⌘P` / `Ctrl+Shift+P`). Some show only when they apply, for example the Track Changes commands while changes are being tracked. Buttons in the Overtex sidebar views and the PDF preview run further commands that are not listed here.

Change a shortcut in **Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts** by searching for the command ID.

| Command | ID | Shortcut |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Overtex: Build LaTeX Project | `overtex.build` | `⌘⌥B` / `Ctrl+Alt+B` |
| Overtex: Cancel Build | `overtex.cancelBuild` |  |
| Overtex: View PDF | `overtex.viewPdf` | `⌘⌥V` / `Ctrl+Alt+V` |
| Overtex: Move PDF Preview to New Window | `overtex.viewer.moveToNewWindow` |  |
| Overtex: Present PDF as Slides | `overtex.viewer.present` |  |
| Overtex: SyncTeX: Jump to PDF | `overtex.forwardSearch` | `⌘⌥J` / `Ctrl+Alt+J` |
| Overtex: Clean Auxiliary Files | `overtex.clean` |  |
| Overtex: Show Build Log | `overtex.showLog` |  |
| Overtex: Check LaTeX Installation | `overtex.checkSetup` |  |
| Overtex: New LaTeX Document | `overtex.newDocument` |  |
| Overtex: Getting Started | `overtex.gettingStarted` |  |
